lines: I didn't think coming up here would be quite so different.
But... there are so many things I want to see.
Um... what am I supposed to do now?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Oh! Fish Co. said they'd be opening housing after my first dive.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Maybe we can get you a room in the townhouse.

lines: A room? Somewhere I can hide?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Yeah! Come on, I'll show you.
